newsitem.title: ITALY: Firms invited to express interest in Italy's Seat.
newsitem.headline: Firms invited to express interest in Italy's Seat.

text.p: Companies wishing to purchase Italian yellow pages publishing company Seat are invited to express their interest by October 3, state industrial holding company IRI announced in a newspaper tombstone.
IRI aims to spin off Seat from state telecoms group Stet and seek a Bourse listing by January 1997 ahead of Stet's privatisation in February or March 1997.
IRI has appointed Lehman Brothers International (Europe) advisor for the planned sale of its stake in Seat following its spin-off from Stet.
The tender is open to all Italian and foreign companies with net assets of at least 50 billion lire. Companies must declare their interest to Lehman Brothers' Milan office by October 3.
IRI is offering to sell 61.27 percent of Seat ordinary and 0.93 percent of savings shares.
